name: the-strange-attractor
_note: THE STRANGE ATTRACTOR (ADR-1850, ADR-1853, ADR-1857..1859): a procedural canyon. The attractorWorld block bakes engine geometry drawn by the scene pass with the canyonRock program (strata, ledge detail normals, baked occlusion from uv.y); Phase 1b look: deeper sky with streak clouds (the analytic sky's cirrus layer, ADR-1864; the volumetric lobes it replaced cost 18-26 ms), two warm unshadowed bounce lights standing in for the canyon's inter-reflection, contact shadows off (they drew a dotted checker on lit walls), shadowCasterReach 4000 m (ADR-1858). docs/prototypes/strange-attractor/. Dimensional portals Gate A: the approach to the portal in the river's east bank wall (ADR-1881), the corruption around it (ADR-1873) and the scan from it (ADR-1872); docs/prototypes/strange-attractor/16-portals-gate-a.md.
